swiftlet.repeat_check

Functions

find_close_cell_repeats

Identify touching or close together cell replicas.

write_close_repeats

Write a report on the number of touching and close cell pairs (CloseRepeatReport) to a HDF5 file.

Classes

CloseRepeatReport

Class to report the result of find_close_cell_repeats.

Full reference

swiftlet.repeat_check.find_close_cell_repeats(lightcone, redshift_range, ang_radius_deg=None, ptype='PartType1', angle_deg=1.0, max_los_separation=None, max_separation=None, output_file=None, warn=True, copies_per_block=4000000)[source]

Identify touching or close together cell replicas.

Find copies of the same cell of a snapshot that lie next to each other (i.e. share a face), or are close together along a line of sight. Computed using only the cell centres (i.e. no particles are read).

Works for any simulation, orientation table, orientation_lock and orientation_seed, but is serial only (a lightcone without a communicator).

Returns a CloseRepeatReport.

Parameters:

  • lightcone (SnapshotLightcone) – the lightcone (SnapshotAllSky or SnapshotBeam), without an MPI communicator

  • redshift_range (tuple) – minimum and maximum redshift of the shell [z_min, z_max]

  • ang_radius_deg (float) – angular radius [deg] of the beam, for a SnapshotBeam; None for SnapshotAllSky

  • ptype (str) – particle type whose cells are used, e.g. “PartType1”

  • angle_deg (float) – two copies within this angle [deg] on the sky are on the same line of sight

  • max_los_separation (float) – copies on the same line of sight closer than this [Mpc] along it are reported. If None, half the box size

  • max_separation (float) – if given, also report every pair of copies closer than this [Mpc]

  • output_file (str) – if given, write the pairs and the closest separation of every repeated cell to this HDF5 file

  • warn (boolean) – if True, warn (CloseRepeatWarning) if touching or line of sight pairs are found

  • copies_per_block (int) – most cell copies compared at once, to limit the memory needed

swiftlet.repeat_check.write_close_repeats(filename, report, lightcone, redshift_range, ang_radius_deg=None)[source]

Write a report on the number of touching and close cell pairs (CloseRepeatReport) to a HDF5 file.

  • The “pairs” and “cells” groups hold arrays of report.pairs and report.cells.

  • The file’s attributes store the counts, the settings of the check, and the

    lightcone’s metadata (simulation, orientation seed, lock and table)

Parameters:

  • filename (str) – path of the HDF5 file

  • report (CloseRepeatReport) – the report of find_close_cell_repeats

  • lightcone (SnapshotLightcone) – the lightcone checked

  • redshift_range (tuple) – minimum and maximum redshift of the shell

  • ang_radius_deg (float) – angular radius [deg] of the beam, None for all-sky

class swiftlet.repeat_check.CloseRepeatReport(nr_tiles: int, nr_cells: int, nr_cell_copies: int, nr_cells_repeated: int, nr_cell_pairs: int, nr_touching: int, nr_line_of_sight: int, closest_separation: float, cell_size: float, boxsize: float, angle_deg: float, max_los_separation: float, pairs: dict, cells: dict)[source]

Bases: object

Class to report the result of find_close_cell_repeats.

nr_cell_copies: number of cell copies in the shell (cells overlapping a tile’s part of the shell) nr_cells_repeated: number of (snapshot, cell) with more than one copy in the shell nr_touching: number of pairs of copies of the same cell that share a face, counted once nr_line_of_sight: number of pairs of copies of the same cell within angle_deg of each other on the sky and

closer than max_los_separation along the line of sight

closest_separation: smallest distance [Mpc] between two copies of the same cell (inf if none is repeated) cell_size: side length [Mpc] of a cell boxsize: side length [Mpc] of the snapshot box angle_deg: angle [deg] used for the line of sight pairs max_los_separation: distance [Mpc] along the line of sight used for the line of sight pairs pairs: the pairs reported (touching, along a line of sight, or closer than max_separation), a

dict of arrays: “snapshot”, “cell”, “tile_a”, “tile_b” (N, 4; the fourth entry is the layer for orientation_lock=”sphere”, -1 otherwise), “centre_a”, “centre_b” (N, 3) [Mpc], “separation” [Mpc], “angle_deg”, “los_separation” [Mpc], “touching” and “line_of_sight” (bool)

cells: every repeated (snapshot, cell): “snapshot”, “cell”, “nr_copies” and

“closest_separation” [Mpc] to its own copies
